basic_details.job_title: MPPGCL ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 11 Posts

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The minimum age for candidates across all categories must be 18 years as of 15 November 2026. For General category candidates, the maximum age limit is 27 years, while for SC, ST, and OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates, a relaxation of 5 years is applicable. Divyang candidates receive a relaxation of 10 years.

qualification.details: Candidates must be native residents of Madhya Pradesh. | Candidates must not have been registered for apprenticeship at any establishment prior to this, nor worked for one year or more.

salary_details.details: No other allowances or benefits are admissible during the apprenticeship period.

selection_process: Selection of apprentices will be based on the merit list prepared according to the marks percentage obtained in ITI (semester or total marks) from the applications received through the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) portal (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in) at Gandhisagar Hydel Power Station (MPPGCL). If marks are equal
priority will be given to older candidates. A waiting list will be utilized if needed.
how_to_apply: Visit the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship's apprenticeship portal at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in.
Go to the Toolbar, click on Apprentices, and select Candidate Registration to create your profile.
Fill in personal details (Personal Details section) including Aadhaar number, category, name, father/mother's name, date of birth, and gender.
Fill in Contact Details with your complete address, mobile number, and e-mail ID and password, which will be used to log in.
Enter your technical and academic qualification details and upload the relevant certificates and documents.
Select your preferred sector/trade for apprenticeship training under the Preference section.
Upload your photo, date of birth certificate, and scanned signature in the fourth stage (Fourth Stage) and click Continue.
Review the filled information on the final preview page, make any necessary corrections using the Edit button, and click Confirm to complete registration.
Log in to the apprenticeship portal using your registered e-mail ID and password.
Go to Establishment Search, search for Gandhisagar Hydel Power Station (MPPGCL), Gandhisagar, and apply for the vacancies shown in the establishment's advertisement.
important_instructions: Vacancies are exclusively for native residents of Madhya Pradesh. Selected apprentices must arrange their own accommodation during the training period. Accommodation may be provided on availability at a prescribed rent. Apprentices must obtain accident insurance (1 year) during the training period, and a copy of the policy must be submitted to the office. An agreement on a Rs. 1000/- stamp paper along with a bond, medical certificate, police verification, and other documents must be submitted to the office. Candidates must register on the apprenticeship portal as a mandatory condition. The company is not obligated to provide employment upon completion of the training. Incomplete or incorrect online applications will be rejected. Candidates can apply for only one trade.

faq.question: Q1. What is MPPGCL ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by Madhya Pradesh Power Generating Company Limited (MPPGCL) to engage 11 ITI apprentices across Electrician, Fitter, and Welder trades at Gandhisagar Hydel Power Station under the Apprentices Act 1961.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under MPPGCL ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 11 vacancies are available, consisting of 5 for Electrician, 5 for Fitter, and 1 for Welder.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MPPGCL ITI Apprentice?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications on the apprenticeship portal is 15 November 2026 up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for MPPGCL ITI Apprentice?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed ITI (one or two years duration) in the concerned trade from a government or non-government recognized industrial training institute (SCVT/NCVT).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MPPGCL ITI Apprentice Recruitment?
faq.answer: The candidate's minimum age must be 18 years as of 15 November 2026, with a maximum age of 27 years for General category candidates, and relaxations of up to 5 years for SC, ST, and OBC candidates, and 10 years for Divyang candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for MPPGCL ITI Apprentice?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for MPPGCL ITI Apprentice?
faq.answer: Candidates must first register on the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) portal at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in, complete their profile, search for "Gandhisagar Hydel Power Station (MPPGCL)" under Establishment Search, and submit their application online.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for MPPGCL ITI Apprentice?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a merit list prepared according to the percentage of marks obtained in ITI.

faq.question: Q9. What is the monthly stipend provided to MPPGCL ITI Apprentices?
faq.answer: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 9600/-.

faq.question: Q10. Does this apprenticeship guarantee a regular job in MPPGCL?
faq.answer: No, the notification explicitly specifies that completion of the apprenticeship training does not give any right to claim employment or a regular job in MPPGCL.
